app.title: mecahub
dev.connect.title: mecahub hub connection test
dev.connect.intro: Developer page. Turn the hub on (press its green button), then press Connect and pick it in the list.
dev.connect.unsupported: This browser cannot use Web Bluetooth. Open this page in Chrome or Edge.
dev.connect.unsupportedLinux: On Linux, Chrome may need this flag enabled: chrome://flags/#enable-experimental-web-platform-features
dev.connect.error.unsupported: This browser cannot use Web Bluetooth.
dev.connect.error.gatt: The Bluetooth connection failed. Check that the hub is on and close to the computer, then try again.
dev.sim.title: mecahub simulator
dev.sim.intro: Developer page. A simulated Move Hub on the left, an app connected to it on the right. Behaviours marked as assumed are not verified on real hardware.
dev.sim.appIntro: Press Connect to link the app to the simulated hub.
dev.sim.sensorsNote: Sensor values use a simple assumed layout, not verified on hardware.
dev.sim.latencyHint: A STOP write that takes longer than its deadline drops the link.
dev.sim.stopPending: Waiting for the motors to stop...
dev.sim.stopFailed: The STOP did not reach the hub. The motors may still be running.
